construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: A document, uniquely identified requirements with nonempty terms and severity, uniquely identified evidence quotes referencing requirements, and routing configuration.
shared_schema.states: input (null review/triage) -> review (validated checks and gaps, null triage) -> complete (validated checks, gaps and tickets).
shared_schema.validation: One validate function at every stage boundary checks exact fields, scalar types, unique identifiers, evidence references, configured routes and priorities. Derived outputs are checked against their deterministic contract.
shared_schema.errors: CLI validation, JSON, encoding, argument and file errors produce one JSON object with status error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Review consumes the validated input envelope and emits evidence checks plus gaps.
Triage consumes only a validated review envelope, generating exactly one ticket per gap and preserving document, requirement, evidence, reason and missing-term references.
Complete output is validated again before printing.

behavior.evidence: Quote must occur verbatim in document text. All requirement terms must match case-insensitive substrings within one or more accepted quotes. Rejected evidence IDs remain visible. No semantic truth or certification is inferred.
behavior.classification: First configured keyword rule matching the gap description or missing terms wins; otherwise use the configured default category.
behavior.priority: Integers 1 (most urgent) through 4. Minimum of configured severity priority and category priority floor prevents category routing from reducing urgency.
behavior.accountability: Every category requires an owner and team, copied onto every routed ticket.
behavior.determinism: Input order preserved; identifiers derived from requirement positions; no clocks, randomness or external calls. Inputs are not mutated.
behavior.empty_requirements: Valid empty review and ticket lists.
behavior.fixture_label: All inputs must explicitly set synthetic to true.

scope.required_prompt_log: docs/My_prompt.txt is retained separately under mandatory repository prompt-logging instructions.

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status complete; 3 checks, 2 gaps, 2 accountable tickets
test_outcomes.error_paths: Covered argument errors, missing file, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, nonstandard constants, invalid schema, invalid encoding and tampered stage handoffs.
